purpose: Governing prospective 2027-28 evaluation of the frozen VotePredict lifecycle program without changing serving probabilities.

modelFreeze.introduction: intro-title-text-eb-v4 fitted only on completed 2021-2026 authoritative introduction-safe rows
modelFreeze.p4: lifecycle-stage-empirical-v1 final fit on frozen P3 2021-2026 snapshots
modelFreeze.p5: core_minus_companion final fit using only process_detail + bill_version under the frozen P5 v2 formula
modelFreeze.p6: reach-source-chamber-passage-vote from frozen P5 retained arm multiplied by the unchanged member-eb-v1.2-decay180 conditional chamber model; P4 stage fallback remains explicit when decomposition is unavailable

preActivationGate.verification: production-data model builder must fail closed if either count is nonzero before the P8 model artifact is frozen

capture.unit: one immutable row per authoritative introduced bill per Minnesota calendar date when eligible
capture.lateSourceDiscovery: never rewrites an existing captured row; missingness at capture remains visible
capture.processFeatures: only persisted official dated process events with occurred_on strictly before cutoff
capture.billVersions: only official versions published strictly before cutoff
capture.memberHistory: only member votes and passage events strictly before cutoff
capture.introductionPrediction: session-pinned frozen 2027 v4 model; introduction-safe source state only

eventTimeEvaluationSelection.rule: daily capture is the immutable source; evaluation collapses it to the latest captured row with cutoff_date strictly before each observed transition/terminal date
eventTimeEvaluationSelection.introductionBenchmark: score the frozen introduction prediction separately at bill level rather than treating a later-discovered daily lifecycle row as an introduction-time lifecycle snapshot

substantiveVehicle.name: substantive_vehicle_passage_v1
substantiveVehicle.relationshipRule: same P7 v1 outcome-blind direct-edge lineage contract, frozen for 2027-28 before joining outcomes

metrics.secondaryVehicleTarget: same metrics, separately labeled and never substituted for strict passage
